August 27, 2026
Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of Banco Popular de Puerto Rico
For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced the execution of the following enforcement actions listed below:
Consent prohibition order against Gadiel Rosario-Alvarado
Former employee of Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, San Juan, Puerto Rico
Misappropriation of customer funds
Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here.
